notes:
Account background: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics for e-commerce merchants). Currently using a mix of off-the-shelf embeddings service + self-hosted lightweight rerankers. Interest started after feature request for conversational product discovery (chat + personalized recs).

Discovery -> evaluation summary: initial discovery call (01/15) with Head of Product (Lena Ortiz) + CTO (Samir Patel). Demo (01/28) of Hosted API chat/embeddings; positive reaction to streaming and model catalog. Team wants to pilot on Hosted API to accelerate time-to-value, then move to Dedicated for predictable latency/cost if POC shows strong unit economics.

Quoted priorities from call: "We need sub-200ms response for autocomplete/suggestions in UI; cost needs to be sub-$0.20 per 1k chat tokens at scale or we won't hit our margins." — Head of Product.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Workloads: chat (session-based), embeddings (batch upsert for product catalog ~2M items), reranking for candidate lists.
- Latency targets: 95th percentile <200ms for single-turn chat with 512-token context; tail latency important for UI.
- Throughput: peak 120 qps for embeddings upserts during nightly jobs; 30-60 rps for chat during peak hours.
- Cost sensitivity: high (mid-market margins). Interested in unit economics modeling.
- Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified models; willing to test 7B-13B quantized variants for cost savings.
- Routing/fallback: want Hosted primary, Dedicated fallback during high load; fallback to smaller quantized model when latency spikes.
- Data/compliance: SSO/SAML for team; audit logs for customer interactions; EU data residency for EU merchant accounts.

POC plan (current):
- Phase 1 (Hosted API, 2 weeks): implement chat and embeddings endpoints, ingest 200k product docs, basic rerank integration. Success metrics: avg latency <220ms, embedding recall @K target, cost per 1k tokens < $0.30 during test workload.
- Phase 2 (Cost optimization/benchmarks, 1 week): run Redwood-led cost-optimization workshop covering batching, KV/prefix caching, and quantization profiles. Deliverables: recommended batching config, cache hit-rate targets, quantization level tradeoffs and projected unit costs for 1M tokens/day.
- Phase 3 (Dedicated pilot, 2-4 weeks): test Dedicated capacity with autoscaling policy, run load test to verify sustained throughput and SLA. Pricing negotiation for 6–12 month commit if Dedicated meets unit economics.

Cost-optimization workshop notes (planned agenda):
- 30m: current workload profile review (token distribution, sequence lengths).
- 30m: batching strategies (dynamic batching windows, max batch size) + expected latency tradeoffs.
- 20m: caching options (prefix/KV cache for repeated prompts, eviction policy targets; expected cache hit-rate impact).
- 30m: quantization profiles (int8/4-bit options, expected quality delta by model size).
- 20m: unit economics model walk-through (tokens-per-session, expected QPS, monthly cost with and without optimization).

Preliminary numbers (from Redwood bench & early POC runs):
- Baseline Hosted cost estimate (unoptimized): ~$0.65 per 1k chat tokens at current model choice (13B float).
- With batching + cache + int8 quantization projected: $0.18–$0.27 per 1k tokens (range depends on cache hit rate and quality tolerance).
- Dedicated candidate: projected committed rate ~30–40% lower than optimized Hosted for steady-state workloads; break-even in ~6 months for their traffic profile.

- 2026-02-19: Workshop scheduling call; agreed to 90-min cost-optimization session week of 2026-02-23.

Open questions / blockers (short):

- Clarify how Redwood Dedicated billing will handle burst capacity pricing. (finance)
- EU data residency mapping for merchant PII and logs. (legal)
